svg.title: What mike does when something goes wrong
svg.desc: Animated diagram of mike's supervisor, which runs every 20 seconds. A worker silent for 5 minutes with unread mail is woken over Remote Control and, if still silent 2 minutes later, replaced. A worker that sends no first request within 90 seconds is closed and opened again up to twice, then shown under NEEDS YOU. A problem such as a check failing in files no task owns goes to the problem-solver, which picks one decision; a problem gets at most three decisions and the third goes to you.
svg.text: Recovery without you, until it needs you

g.text: A worker goes quiet with mail waiting
After 5 minutes silent with unread mail, mike wakes it over Remote Control.
Still silent 2 minutes later, it is closed and a new worker takes the task.
No first request within 90 seconds: mike closes it and opens it again,
up to twice. After that it shows under NEEDS YOU.
A problem needs a decision, not a restart
The problem-solver reads the run and picks one decision. One problem
gets at most three decisions, and the third goes to you.
